rebuildProcedure: Use each scene path from delivery-state.json. Render the complete Pillow sequence with --aa 1 and a retained --frames-dir.
For each override, run the same Pillow scene/output/cache with --aa set to the listed value and --ranges set to the inclusive intervals. Retain the base capture and per-range provenance.
Run scripts/final_encode.py for the completed lossless cache to produce coherent full-range BT.709 encoding, then scripts/finalize_delivery.py --mux for reference audio.
